samples.summary: Todo doc lists capture-collect.yml's missing producer guard as unresolved work for a maintainer, but the guard already exists in the repository's current .github/workflows/capture-collect.yml.
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260825-promote-exit-code-default-todo.md:172-186 states under 'Round 4: needs a maintainer' that 'capture-collect.yml has no producer guard' and proposes adding an `if:` clause checking `github.event.workflow_run.path` against the two producer files. But .github/workflows/capture-collect.yml:139-143 already contains essentially that guard (event_name check, conclusion != skipped, head_repository match, and path == '.github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml' || path == '.github/workflows/agent-review-on-demand.yml'). The todo item appears stale relative to the actual code state, and would mislead a future reader (or maintainer) into thinking this fix is still outstanding.
